channel.title: Kahoa Coffee Blog: From the Highlands
channel.description: Stories from our Kenyan coffee-farming family, plus guides to Kenyan coffee and how to brew it. The Kahoa Coffee blog, from Austin, TX.

item.title: Picking Coffee Cherries on a Kenyan Farm
item.author: info@kahoa.shop (Martin Kibuthu)
item.description: My earliest memories of Kenya: a thermos of tea, a small bucket, red coffee cherries and a bumpy ride to the factory. The story behind Kahoa.
